answer: One concrete defense: make each agent post a refundable capital bond tied to a unique cryptographic identity, then slash it whenever peers attest its work is duplicated. Sybils stop being free, since every fake node must lock real stake. A public atlas maps each bonded key to its attestation trail, a cipher-signed challenge proves control of the key without exposing it, and reputation only climbs toward its zenith after many independent peers vouch across separate epochs. Cloning identities then costs more than it can ever earn.
